script.title: FILING A NOISE COMPLAINT
script.story_hook: Filing a noise complaint against a loud neighbor.
script.intro_zh: 對吵鬧的鄰居提出噪音投訴。
script.welcome_en: Hey friends, welcome back! Today: filing a noise complaint.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨朋友們，歡迎回來！今天的主題：噪音投訴。
script.outro: Hope you all sleep well tonight. Keep listening, see you next time!
script.outro_zh: 希望大家今晚都能一覺好眠。持續練習聽力，下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's your turn: read each line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在換你跟著我，一句一句朗讀。

script.char_b_description: a tall Middle Eastern man in his early fifties with slicked-back gray hair and a thick mustache, wearing a brown blazer over a turtleneck, clasping his hands calmly
script.youtube_title: 【🔊🏢噪音投訴英文】「安靜時段十點開始」怎麼說？18句跟管理員反應的實戰對話🌙｜Noise Complaint English
script.youtube_title_en: “Our Quiet Hours Start at Ten” — Filing a Noise Complaint
script.youtube_description:
鄰居半夜開派對，睡不著該怎麼辦？別自己生悶氣！這段18句的噪音投訴對話，教你向管理員說清楚狀況、留下噪音記錄、詢問安靜時段與正式處理流程。整段自然美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就會禮貌又堅定地表達不滿。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Neighbors partying late and you can't sleep? Don't suffer in silence! This 18-line noise complaint dialogue shows you how to describe the problem to a building manager, keep a noise log, ask about quiet hours, and request formal action. Natural American English with IPA and translation, then repeat every line out loud in the second half.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🏠噪音投訴英文｜反映狀況・噪音記錄・安靜時段與警告｜聽完就會投訴｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
鄰居每晚吵鬧，英文卻不知如何開口反應？
直接找他們理論，還是找管理員比較有用？

這一集帶大家走進大樓管理室，跟著房客從說明派對噪音、出示記錄的時間，到了解安靜時段規定與警告函處理流程，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🔊 說明狀況：例如「they host loud parties most nights」、「hard to sleep」。
📓 提出證據：例如「I wrote down times, like last night till two」。
🌙 詢問規定：例如「our quiet hours start at ten」、「send them an official warning」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

願每個好眠的夜晚，都有英文幫你發聲！
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a small notebook of noise notes

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, do you have a minute? It's about unit 4B.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ du ju hæv ə ˈmɪnɪt ɪts əˈbaʊt ˈjunɪt fɔr bi/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，你有空嗎？我想談談 4B 那戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr wʌts ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɑn wɪð fɔr bi/
dialogue.zh: 當然，4B 那邊發生什麼事？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, they host loud parties most nights this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðeɪ hoʊst laʊd ˈpɑrtiz moʊst naɪts ðɪs wik/
dialogue.zh: 他們這週幾乎每天晚上都開吵鬧的派對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Again? Okay, that's really frustrating, I'm sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡɛn oʊˈkeɪ ðæts ˈrɪli ˈfrʌstreɪtɪŋ aɪm ˈsɑri/
dialogue.zh: 又是他們？很抱歉，那真的讓人很崩潰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's hard to sleep, and I work early mornings.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts hɑrd tə slip ænd aɪ wɜrk ˈɜrli ˈmɔrnɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 很難入睡，而且我每天早上要上早班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I understand. Have you tried talking to them?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd hæv ju traɪd ˈtɔkɪŋ tə ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 我了解。你有試過跟他們溝通嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did, once. They said sorry, then repeated it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd wʌns ðeɪ sɛd ˈsɑri ðɛn rɪˈpitɪd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 試過一次，他們說完抱歉，下次又照樣開派對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay. Did you keep any notes of the noise?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ dɪd ju kip ˈɛni noʊts əv ðə nɔɪz/
dialogue.zh: 好的。你有沒有記錄下噪音發生的時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I wrote down times, like last night till two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ ˈrɔt daʊn taɪmz laɪk læst naɪt tɪl tu/
dialogue.zh: 有，我寫下了時間，像昨晚就吵到兩點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that helps. Our quiet hours start at ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ðæt hɛps ˈaʊər ˈkwaɪət aʊrz stɑrt ət tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這很有用。我們的安靜時段從十點開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, so they clearly know the rule already.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt soʊ ðeɪ ˈklɪrli noʊ ðə rul ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 對啊，所以他們明明就知道這條規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll send them an official warning today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛnd ðɛm ən əˈfɪʃəl ˈwɔrnɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我今天會寄一份正式的警告通知給他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would it help to check the hallway camera too?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ɪt hɛlp tə tʃɛk ðə ˈhɔlˌweɪ ˈkæmərə tu/
dialogue.zh: 那調查看走廊的監視器會有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're adding noise sensors in halls next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪr ˈædɪŋ nɔɪz ˈsɛnsərz ɪn hɔls nɛkst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 我們下個月會在各樓層走廊裝噪音感應器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, that would give me some proof.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd ðæt wʊd ɡiv mi sʌm pruf/
dialogue.zh: 哦很好，那樣就有客觀證據了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If it continues, please call me right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ɪt kənˈtinjuz pliz kɔl mi raɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 如果情況還持續，請立刻打電話給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Thanks for taking this seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl θæŋks fər ˈteɪkɪŋ ðɪs ˈsɪriəsli/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。謝謝你認真處理這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's my job. Sleep well tonight, hopefully!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪ dʒɑb slip wɛl təˈnaɪt ˈhoʊpfəli/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的職責。希望你今晚能睡個好覺！
